heroHeadline: Day 730: Sheinbaum Announces Decree on Violent Online Content After Torreón School Attack
heroSubtitle: On October 2, 2026, Sheinbaum said the government is drafting a decree obliging digital platforms to remove posts inciting violence after an attack at a Torreón secondary school, and marked the 58th anniversary of Tlatelolco.
